Pre-GA features are available 'as is' and might have limited support.
a highly compliant, enterprise-ready version of Gemini Notebook

result.notes: The consumer-facing NotebookLM product (notebooklm.google.com) has no public API at all. Programmatic access only exists through 'Gemini Notebook Enterprise' (formerly NotebookLM Enterprise), a separately-purchased enterprise product built on Google Cloud's Discovery Engine, requiring a GCP project, IAM role 'Cloud NotebookLM User', and enterprise identity federation. The REST API is at v1alpha (pre-GA/preview) and covers a small set of operations (create/get/list/delete/share notebooks, sources, audio overviews). No official vendor MCP server exists; only unofficial/community MCP wrappers (e.g. Pantheon-Security/notebooklm-mcp-secure, mcp-dir/notebooklm-mcp) exist, and these explicitly note there is no official API and typically rely on browser automation rather than the enterprise REST API.
result.one_liner: NotebookLM is Google's AI-powered research/notetaking tool that lets users upload sources and get grounded summaries, Q&A, and audio overviews; programmatic access exists only via the separately-sold 'Gemini Notebook Enterprise' Google Cloud REST API.
